title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Organisational Theory
description: The course aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of organisational frameworks and perspectives.
longDescription: This course aims to provide students with an in-depth understanding of the key components of organizational frameworks and perspectives, including the principles of organizational structure and design, the impact of the corporate work environment on employee behaviour and productivity, and the role of organizational power and politics in shaping decision-making processes. Through a comprehensive exploration of organizational behaviour culture and values, students will gain a deeper understanding of the factors that contribute to developing positive and effective organizational cultures and the challenges associated with creating and maintaining a healthy organizational climate.
courseDetails: Types of Organisational Structure. Formal Organisational Structure Model. Stages of Organisational Structure. Strategic Environment. Detailed view of Organisational Design. A Step-by-Step Approach to Organisational Design Process. Milestones of Organisational Design. Basic Concept & Role of HR in Organization. Job Design In Organization. The Performance Management System. The Performance Management Cycle. Communication framework. Conflict Resolution. Employees well-being. Employee Well-being Programme. Structure & Faces of Organizational Culture. Dimensions & Macro Culture. Cultural integrity & Cross Culture. Impact on management & Energetic awareness. Diversity & Incline, External Adaptation and Internal Integrity. Communication & Hierarchy. Impact on organizational Success & Value congruence. Japanese Culture. Overview of organizational Norms. Integrity Ethics Covid-19 Impact. Organizational Norm Theory. Society Context & Social Influence. This course aims to provide students with a deep understanding of the fundamental concepts of organizational frameworks and perspectives, including the importance of organizational structure and design, the influence of corporate work environment on organizational effectiveness, the impact of organizational power and political framework on decision-making processes, and the significance of organizational behaviour culture and values in shaping organizational culture and success. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Understanding Organizational Frameworks and Perspectives: Organizational Structure and Design: Corporate Work Environment: HR Strategies: Work Environment: Psychological Environment: Organizational Power and Politics Framework: Governing Bodies: Power: Politics: Conflict Framework. Organizational Behaviour Culture and Values: Organizational Culture: Organizational Values: Organizational Norms:
